name: Benchmark v2 Set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: 'Number of tasks to benchmark'
        required: true
        default: '2'
        type: number
        min: 1
        max: 10
      agent:
        description: 'Agent to use'
        required: true
        default: 'default-agent'
      provider:
        description: 'Provider to use'
        required: true
        default: 'default-provider'
      model:
        description: 'Model to use'
        required: true
        default: 'default-model'
      timeout:
        description: 'Timeout in seconds'
        required: true
        default: '300'
        type: number

jobs:
  set-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      tasks: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.tasks }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set matrix
        id: set-matrix
        run: |
          tasks=$(jq -c '.tasks[0:${{ inputs.task_count }}] | map(.id)' data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json)
          echo "tasks=$tasks" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  benchmark:
    needs: set-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        task: ${{ fromJSON(needs.set-matrix.outputs.tasks) }}
      max-parallel: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
